StartupDescription.prompt: What your product does, in one plain sentence anyone can picture
StartupDescription.example: a bench-top robot that runs routine blood tests

SignerName.prompt: Who signs for them (a named person)

SignerTitle.prompt: Their title (someone who can influence or approve budget)

Problem.prompt: The problem, as the counterparty describes it
Problem.example: routine blood tests are run by hand, which ties up two technologists on every shift

ExpiryDate.prompt: Date this letter lapses (YYYY-MM-DD; blank = 90 days after the letter date)

NextStep.prompt: The specific next step, with a date
NextStep.example: a scoping call with the lab and IT teams by 2027-01-15

GoverningLaw.default: the Province of Ontario and the federal laws of Canada that apply there

customer.title: Customer intent to purchase
customer.use: A prospect intends to buy once the product meets stated needs. Traction evidence for investors and grants.

Quantity.prompt: How much they expect to buy (units, seats, sites)

PriceIndication.prompt: Price or budget range they indicated

TargetDate.prompt: When they expect to buy (date or quarter)

PurchaseConditions.prompt: What must be true before they buy
PurchaseConditions.example: the robot matches manual results on a 200-sample comparison

AnnualValue.prompt: Indicative annual value as a plain number, for your pipeline

pilot.title: Pilot intent
pilot.use: A prospect intends to run a time-boxed pilot with agreed success criteria.

PilotScope.example: one robot running the top 5 routine panels on the day shift

SuccessCriteria.example: 95% agreement with manual results and a 30% reduction in technologist hours

PilotFee.prompt: Pilot fee (blank if unpaid; a paid pilot is much stronger evidence)

ConversionIntent.prompt: What happens if the pilot succeeds
ConversionIntent.example: enter discussions to deploy at 3 further sites at $40,000 per unit per year

AnnualValue.prompt: Indicative annual value if it converts, as a plain number

design-partner.title: Design partner
design-partner.use: A prospect intends to shape the product through regular feedback in exchange for early access.

PartnerCommitment.prompt: What they will give (time, data, access)
PartnerCommitment.example: a 45-minute feedback session every two weeks with the lab supervisor

PartnerBenefit.example: early access and 30% off list price for the first two years

PriceIndication.prompt: Expected price after the partnership (blank if not discussed)

AnnualValue.prompt: Indicative annual value if they convert, as a plain number

health-pilot.title: Health organization pilot intent
health-pilot.use: A hospital, clinic or lab intends to pilot. Adds privacy, ethics and procurement steps.

ClinicalChampion.prompt: Clinical lead who will sponsor the pilot, with title
ClinicalChampion.example: Dr. Alex Chen, Chief of Laboratory Medicine

PilotScope.example: the outpatient lab, routine chemistry panels only

SuccessCriteria.example: turnaround time under 45 minutes and no increase in repeat tests

ConversionIntent.prompt: What happens if the pilot succeeds
ConversionIntent.example: enter procurement discussions for a site-wide deployment

AnnualValue.prompt: Indicative annual value if it converts, as a plain number

letter-of-support.title: Letter of support for a grant or program
letter-of-support.use: An organization supports your application and states what it would contribute.

ProgramName.prompt: Grant or program you are applying to

SupportRole.example: host the validation study and share anonymized results

InKindContribution.prompt: In-kind or cash contribution (blank if none)
InKindContribution.example: 40 hours of technologist time, valued at about $3,000

AnnualValue.prompt: Annual value for your pipeline (0 if none)

partnership.title: Partnership, channel or supplier
partnership.use: A partner intends to resell, integrate, supply or co-develop.

PartnershipType.example: distribution of the robot to independent labs in Ontario

PartnerRole.example: introduce the product to its 60 lab customers and handle installation

StartupRole.example: supply units, training and second-line support

AnnualValue.prompt: Indicative annual value, as a plain number
